concept.title: Policies and managed preferences
concept.shortdesc: BPM separates Firefox Enterprise policies from managed preference values while keeping both in one profile.

conbody.p: Policies are named Firefox Enterprise controls such as browser behavior, access, permissions, or feature settings. Managed preferences are preference keys with values and optional lock behavior.
Guided editor covers common policy goals. All settings exposes the broader supported catalog. JSON editor shows the exact document boundary used for import and export.
Policy-by-policy reference details belong to the Firefox Policy Guide; this User Guide explains how a user reaches and safely edits those controls in BPM.
